# harfbuzzjs 1.6.4 (vendored: hb-subset wasm only)
- Source: npm registry tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/harfbuzzjs/-/harfbuzzjs-1.6.4.tgz (published 2026-10-22), licence MIT (LICENSE here; HarfBuzz itself is the MIT-style "Old MIT" licence, compiled into the wasm).
- Tarball integrity (registry metadata, checked against the downloaded file before extracting; scratch folder, nothing executed): `sha512-T/PyfhVt1gGR2Tkf5KJUj1DQFkVBXHw552lS1iLEEDhV1Lukb3eq1pk2ov85kgbT2YUiZtJBTak9w+M7YgzUEQ==`
- Vendored on 2026-11-15: only `dist/harfbuzz-subset.wasm` (683,531 bytes; no imports, exports `memory malloc free hb_blob_* hb_face_* hb_set_* hb_subset_*`) and `LICENSE`. Our own wrapper is `tools/web/fontsubset.js` (the package's JS glue is not used). SHA256SUMS lists our copies; `tools/check/check_web_flasher.py` verifies them.
- Upgrade: new folder next to this one, repeat the download in a scratch folder, check the sha512, update `HB_VERSION` in `tools/web/fontsubset.js`, never edit the wasm.

The wasm is built by Emscripten and carries its runtime support code: Emscripten's LICENSE (MIT / UIUC), https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/main/LICENSE at commit 9d21a55cd13c18299f18d8c3dc5a1cf165f64185 (the emsdk version used for the build is not recorded in the package: the licence file has not changed since 2016).
